payload.summary: Planned the revision-aware semantic index registry as an additive foundation for the project-context refresh lifecycle. The user's explicit autopilot-roadmap command is recorded as inherited approval of both the roadmap-selected direction and this implementation-ready plan.
completed_work: Created proposal, selected approach, design, strict delta spec, TDD task plan, DB and JSON contracts, and validated work-package DAG.
Recorded Gate 1 and Gate 2 as inherited approval from the explicit autopilot-roadmap invocation.

decisions.title: Separate repository metadata from index lifecycle records
decisions.rationale: An additive code_search_indexes table preserves current readers while making exact revision and namespace lifecycle authoritative.

decisions.title: Persist full Git object IDs and explicit namespaces
decisions.rationale: Resolved revisions plus main, feature, and work_package kinds prevent ref movement and branch-local work from masquerading as canonical main.

decisions.title: Guard lifecycle updates with leases and canonical promotion with compare-and-swap
decisions.rationale: Concurrent or late workers cannot overwrite newer results, and only a ready main index for the same repository can become canonical.

decisions.title: Garbage collect only expired noncanonical namespaces
decisions.rationale: Storage deletion remains retryable while main and canonical records are excluded by both SQL and application guards.

decisions.title: Accept inherited roadmap approval for planning gates
decisions.rationale: The explicit $autopilot-roadmap project-context-refresh-lifecycle command approves the roadmap-selected direction and automatic progression without per-item pauses.

next_steps: Implement wp-contracts, then wp-migration, wp-registry, and wp-integration in DAG order.
Use code_search_indexes as the sole revision-specific source of truth in complete-incremental-semantic-indexing.

relevant_files.description: identity, lifecycle, canonical, and GC decisions
